outcome: Antibiotic Resistance Genes (ARGs) composition and quantity
cohort: The study included 72 healthy infants whose resistome was tracked from 7 days to 4 months of age, initially identified from pooled healthy mother-infant pairs in the MAMI cohort.
finding: The abundance of most ARGs increased over the first four months of life, while mobile genetic elements decreased significantly, illustrating the ARG evolution and dynamics in the infant gut.
mod_finding: Mode of birth had a significant impact on ARG composition at 7 days and 4 months, playing a fundamental role in shaping early-life resistance profiles.
